title: Ancient Gesture Sherd
description: Six Seven.. haha! Changes the Arms Up Pottery Sherd. Sorry.
body:
The Arms Up Sherd is a nice little Sherd. But what if it was Six Seven, the worst meme of the year? 
Well. Here it is. I'm not actually sorry. Have fun.

...I spent maybe half an hour on this... it's really not much. Two textures were changed, one item name change...

Awesome Six Seven...
